name: p6_lem23_eq6
statement: (k n : ℤ) : p6_kfib k (2 * n) = p6_kfib k n * (p6_kfib k (n - 1) + p6_kfib k (n + 1))
closed: ∀ (k n : ℤ), p6_kfib k (2 * n) = p6_kfib k n * (p6_kfib k (n - 1) + p6_kfib k (n + 1))
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n) = Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n * (Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n - 1) + Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1))
